turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Hey Jun, how's it going this morning?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Pretty good, Gus. Just finishing up the sample prep.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Nice. Anything interesting on the agenda today?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: The booking reference for the greenhouse door is WILLOW3-2521.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I'll make sure the access is set.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Did you manage to get the pH readings from the last batch?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Yes, they're stable and within the expected range.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great, that should keep the project on track.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: I'm thinking of grabbing a quick bite before the afternoon run.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Sounds good, see you later.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Hey, this cafe smells amazing today.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: I know, the barista just made a fresh batch of cinnamon latte.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Glad you both are here. By the way, the password for the boat house is EMBER2-7308.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Thanks, I’ll jot that down. Did you manage to finish the project you were working on?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Almost, just need a final review. How about you? How was your morning?

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Pretty relaxed, went for a walk by the river before heading here.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Sounds nice. I spent a while reading the new novel I got last week.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: I’ve been thinking of trying the pastry they have today, looks tempting.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Let’s order a couple and catch up on the weekend plans.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Hey Lea, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Pretty good, just grabbed a latte. What about you?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Same here, I was running late because I couldn't find the bike shed.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Oh? Did you finally locate it?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Yes, the label on the bike shed is MOSAIC3-1506.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: That's oddly specific. Does it mean anything to you?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Not really, just a quirky label they put up. I think they wanted to make it sound high‑tech.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Ha, maybe they're planning a robot bike attendant.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Would be cool. Anyway, any plans after this coffee?

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Just a quick walk to the park, then back to finish some reports. You?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Hey Dee, how's your day going so far?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks! By the way, the booking reference for the field kit is ZEPHYR-7217.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Great, that should make the pickup smoother. Did you manage to get the kit sorted out already?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Just about. I grabbed a quick bite and I'm heading back to the lab now.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Nice, I was just finishing up the sample prep for the afternoon run.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Sounds like we’re both on track. I have a brief catch‑up with the data team later.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Good to hear. Do you think we’ll have time to run the calibration before the evening shift?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: I’ll double‑check the inventory and let you know if anything’s missing.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Appreciate it. I can swing by the storage room if you need an extra hand.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Thanks, Ivo. Let’s touch base in a bit and make sure everything’s set.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Hey Lea, the roses are finally opening. How's your morning been?

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished watering the tomatoes. By the way, the label on the telescope dome is FROST-9873.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Thanks for the heads‑up! I was about to ask you about that. Did you notice any new sprouts?

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Yes, the basil is looking lush, and the marigolds are bright as ever.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: I love how the sunlight hits the garden after a light rain.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Same here. I even saw a hummingbird hovering near the lavender.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: That’s wonderful. I was thinking of adding a small bench over there by the oak.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Good idea. It’ll be a nice spot to rest after we tend the beds.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Do you want to grab a cup of tea after we finish pruning the rosemary?

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Absolutely, a break sounds perfect.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Morning, everyone! How's the coffee today?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: It's strong enough to wake the whole workshop up.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: The name chosen for the bike shed is FROST2-7457.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: FROST2-7457 sounds like something out of a sci‑fi movie.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Yeah, it does. I was just fixing the printer and it started humming like a spaceship.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: I think it'll attract the right kind of attention, especially from the kids.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Speaking of kids, I saw a group drawing a mural on the wall.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: They used bright colors, made the space feel alive.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Maybe we can hang the new schedule near the bike shed, so everyone sees it.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Good idea, let's put it up after lunch.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: I'll grab the markers and help.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Thanks, I'll bring the ladder.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Hey fay, nice to see you. This place smells amazing.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Hey gus! Yeah, the aroma is comforting.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: How's your morning been?

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Pretty busy, I had to check the kiln before heading out.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: The code for the kiln is PIXEL1-6301.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Got it. Did everything run smoothly?

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: It did, thanks. I was worried it might need a tweak.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Glad to hear that. I’m just sipping my latte and watching the street.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Same here, I think I’ll order a pastry. Want to share?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Sure, a croissant sounds perfect.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Great, let's enjoy the break before the afternoon rush.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Absolutely, it’s nice to pause and chat.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Morning, Kai! The garden looks especially fresh today.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: It does. I was just watering the tomatoes.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Those tomatoes have been thriving. Did you add any new compost?

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Just a bit of leaf mulch. By the way, the name chosen for the tool chest is ORBIT-6119.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: That's a cool name! It sounds futuristic.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I thought it would stand out among the garden tools.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Speaking of tools, I need to sharpen the pruning shears.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I can fetch the stone for that. It's near the back fence.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Thanks, that would save me a trip.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: No problem. After that, maybe we can plant some basil near the rosemary.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Hey guys, nice to finally sit down in this cozy cafe.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: I know, right? The coffee smells amazing.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Morning rush was crazy, but I managed to get through it.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: What did you end up working on today?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Just some inventory updates. By the way, the code for the storeroom is WILLOW-6990.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I was wondering where the supplies are kept.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I had a meeting that ran longer than expected, but now I can relax.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Same here, I’m looking forward to trying that new pastry they just added.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Sounds good, let’s order a couple and catch up on the weekend plans.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Hey Jun, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the spectrometer.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Nice! Did you get a chance to look at the new field kit we ordered?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Yes, the name chosen for the field kit is WILLOW2-8269.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: WILLOW2-8269 has a nice ring to it. I think it'll work well for the river sampling.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Agreed. By the way, have you decided what you want for lunch?

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: I'm thinking about the salad bar today, maybe add a bit of fruit.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Sounds fresh. Did the data from yesterday's run look okay to you?

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Mostly, yes. There were a few spikes that I think we can clean up with a simple baseline correction.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great, I'll dive into that after lunch. Let's catch up later this afternoon.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Hey Kai, nice to see you. How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Morning, Jun! It's been pretty busy, but I managed to grab a coffee before the rush.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Same here. I was thinking about that storeroom we need to check later.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: The booking reference for the storeroom is MAPLE-6591.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I’ll make sure we have the right key when we get there.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Do you want to sit by the window? It’s a nice spot to watch people pass by.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Sure, that sounds good. The light is perfect for reading the notes we took.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Speaking of notes, I finally finished the draft for the project proposal.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great! I’m looking forward to hearing your ideas. Anything surprising you found?

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Just that the client prefers a more relaxed tone, which fits well with what we discussed earlier.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Hey Dee, nice to see you. How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Hey Bo, pretty good. I just grabbed a latte. How about you?

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Same here, the coffee here never disappoints. Did you finish that project you were working on?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Almost. I just need to pop into the lab to get the sample. The password for the sample fridge is HARBOR2-1126.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Got it. I hope the experiment goes smoothly. Anything else on your agenda today?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Just a meeting later and then maybe a walk in the park if the weather holds up.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Sounds nice. I was thinking of catching up on some reading after this.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: What are you reading these days?

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: A collection of short stories I found at the library. They’re perfect for a coffee break.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: That sounds perfect. Let’s enjoy our drinks and chat a bit longer.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Hey Dee, nice sunshine today, huh?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: It really is. I was just finishing up some paperwork before coming out.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Anything interesting at the office?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Just the usual inventory checks. The label on the archive cabinet is RIDGE2-5850, so I had to double‑check that it matches the log.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Good thing you caught that. Those labels can be tricky.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Yeah, and now I'm glad to be out here. How are your tomatoes doing?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: They're finally starting to blush. I think they'll be ready to pick soon.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Sounds promising. I should water the rosemary before it gets too dry.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Let me know if you need an extra hose; I have a spare.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that later.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Morning, Ivo! How's the coffee this morning?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Morning, Fay! It's strong enough to keep me awake for the calibrations.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: I finally got the new sensor mounted on the test rig.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Nice! The combination for the lab safe is NECTAR2-3659.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I'll grab the spare parts from there.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Did you see the schedule for the safety briefing later?

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: I think it's after lunch, but I haven't checked the board yet.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Make sure to bring your notebook; we need to note the temperature logs.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Will do. By the way, did the new firmware fix the glitch you reported?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Yes, it runs smooth now. The system is finally behaving.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Hey Hana, I just finished checking out that design book you recommended.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Nice! Did you find any inspiration for your project?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: I was just looking for a quiet corner to finish my thesis. How's your day going?

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: Pretty good, actually. The name chosen for the kiln is PIXEL3-8530.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Oh, that's a cool name! Does it have a story behind it?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: I think it sounds futuristic, like something out of a sci‑fi art studio.

turns.speaker: dee12
turns.text: We joked that it's a secret code for our next exhibition.

turns.speaker: hana12
turns.text: Speaking of exhibitions, I'm meeting a curator later. Hope the library's Wi‑Fi holds up.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: It usually does. Let me know if you need any quiet space for prep.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Hey Ivo, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Pretty good, just grabbed a latte. How about you?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Same here, the coffee line was short today.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: The label on the tool chest is QUILL1-9542.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Oh right, I need to remember that for the workshop later.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Did you get a chance to finish that report you were working on?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Just about, I was planning to send it out after lunch.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Nice, I hope the client likes the new design.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: They seemed pretty excited when I showed the mockup.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Great to hear! Maybe we can celebrate with another coffee later.

turns.speaker: ivo12

turns.text: Yes, they add a bright splash. I might trim the hedges after lunch.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Good idea. I need to water the carrots before the sun gets too strong.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: I'll bring the watering can over and we can share the work.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great, teamwork makes the garden thrive.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: Hey, the garden feels so fresh today, doesn't it?

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: It really does. I was just admiring how the roses are opening up.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: The name chosen for the boat house is MAPLE2-3006.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: That's a solid name. It fits the wooden vibe we were aiming for.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Speaking of wood, have you both seen the new trellis I put up over the tomatoes?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: I noticed it this morning. The tomatoes look ready to burst with flavor.

turns.speaker: bo12
turns.text: The sun's just right for a quick stretch. I feel like I could stay out here all day.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Same here. I brought a thermos of coffee to keep the chill away.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great idea. Let's enjoy the garden a little longer before we head back.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Morning, cy12! How's the coffee today?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Morning! It's decent, though a bit weak. I just finished checking the hallway signs.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Anything interesting?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: The label on the west stairwell is RIDGE-4235.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Got it. That helps for the maintenance log.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Yeah, I was going to add it before the meeting.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Speaking of, did you manage to finish the sample prep?

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Almost. I just need to run the final calibration.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Cool, let me know if you need a hand.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Will do. After that, I might grab a snack and catch up on that new podcast.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Morning, Jun. Did you get a chance to grab coffee before the experiment?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Yeah, I grabbed a quick espresso. Feeling ready for the calibrations.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Great. By the way, any updates on the storage locker you mentioned?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: The code for the boat house is LUMEN2-3018.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I'll make a note and check the equipment there later.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Cool. How's the new microscope setup coming along?

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: It's almost done, just need to align the lenses. Should be good by lunch.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Perfect timing. I was thinking we could run a quick test after that.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Anything else on your agenda today?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Just finishing the data logs and then maybe a short walk outside if the weather holds up.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Morning, everyone! Did you both manage to get a good start on the samples today?

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Hey Cy! I was able to prep the polymer mix before the coffee break, so I'm feeling optimistic.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Glad to hear it. I just finished calibrating the spectrometer, so everything should be ready for the next run.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Great. Are we still on track to fire the new batch in the kiln this afternoon?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: The booking reference for the kiln is CEDAR1-8142.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Perfect, thanks Jun. I'll load the samples right after lunch.

turns.speaker: cy12
turns.text: Speaking of lunch, did anyone try the new sandwich shop down the hall? Their avocado toast is amazing.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: I did, and the coffee there is surprisingly good too. I might swing by for a quick cup before the afternoon meeting.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's reconvene after the kiln run and see how the results look.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Morning, Gus! The roses are finally opening up.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Good to see you, Fay. I was just watering the herbs.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: I spent most of the morning sorting the mail.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: The code for the reading room is EMBER-7252.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Thanks, I’ll note that. By the way, the booking reference for the seminar room is TUNDRA-8946.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Got it. Did you manage to finish the report you were working on?

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Almost. I’m just polishing the conclusions now.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Nice. The sun is getting strong; we should take a short break.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Agreed. Let’s grab a coffee and enjoy the garden view.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Sounds perfect.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Hey guys, nice sunshine today, huh?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Yeah, the tomatoes are finally ripening.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: I was just watering the rosemary; it looks greener than ever.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Speaking of green, I remembered something from earlier – the code for the reading room is EMBER-7252.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Thanks for passing that along, Fay. I needed it for the meeting later.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: Good timing. I was about to head over after I finish pruning the roses.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: How's the compost pile coming along?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Slow but steady; I added some kitchen scraps this morning.

turns.speaker: lea12
turns.text: I think the bees are happy with the new lavender we planted.

turns.speaker: fay12
turns.text: Great! Let's enjoy the garden a bit longer before we all head out.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Morning, Kai! How's the workshop treating you today?

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Hey Jun! It's humming along, just finished calibrating the cutter.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Great to hear. By the way, the name chosen for the greenhouse door is QUILL3-6925.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Nice, that'll look sharp. And the combination for the storeroom is TUNDRA3-2054.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Thanks, I’ll label the door tomorrow. I spent the morning patching that leak on the east wall.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I was sorting the new supplies, making sure we have enough pipe and sealant.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Did you manage to grab a coffee before the shift? I’m running low.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I grabbed a cup right after the cutter, it kept me going through the inventory check.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Perfect timing. I’m looking forward to testing the new sensor array after lunch.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Sounds good. Let’s meet back at the bench in a little while and compare notes.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Hey everyone, how's your day shaping up?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Not too bad, just finished tweaking the sensor array.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: I've been juggling a lot of paperwork, but I managed to step outside for a quick walk.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Did you hear what they settled on for the greenhouse door name?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: The name chosen for the greenhouse door is QUILL3-6925.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: That's a cool name, definitely memorable.

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Yeah, it has a nice ring to it, like something out of a sci‑fi novel.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: I grabbed a sandwich from the kitchen, you should try the veggie one if you haven't yet.

turns.speaker: kai12
turns.text: Thanks, I might later; are we still on for the project review this afternoon?

turns.speaker: ivo12
turns.text: Absolutely, see you both there.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Hey Gus, did you get a chance to look at the new parts this morning?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Yeah, I grabbed the schematics and started on the boat house panel.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: The label on the boat house is ZEPHYR3-3078.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Got it, that matches what I saw on the wall. Anything else stand out?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: I also checked the server rack, making sure everything is wired correctly.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: The code for the server rack is HARBOR-9862.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Thanks, I'll note that. Did you run into any hiccups with the wiring?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Just a loose connector, but I tightened it. The system should stay stable now.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Great. I’m planning to calibrate the sensor array after lunch.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Sounds good. Let me know if you need a hand with the calibrations.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Hey guys, how's the day treating you so far?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Pretty good, just wrapped up a meeting. How about you, Jun?

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Not bad, I've been tinkering with the new prototype and it finally stopped glitching.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Nice! Anything interesting happen while you were at the workshop?

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Actually, someone mentioned to me earlier that the label on the boat house is ZEPHYR3-3078.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: Oh, that's useful to know—thanks for passing that along.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: I grabbed a quick bite from the cafeteria, you two should join next time.

turns.speaker: gus12
turns.text: Sounds good, the weather's finally clearing up, perfect for a short walk after work.

turns.speaker: jun12
turns.text: I was thinking of checking out the new exhibit in the lobby later.

turns.speaker: eli12
turns.text: Cool, let’s meet up there after we finish up here.
